edges.reason: Constructor assigns governance from msg.sender, granting owner privileges
acceptGovernance requires msg.sender == pendingGovernance before transferring ownership
collectProtocolFees is gated by onlyGovernance checking msg.sender == governance
setGovernance only callable by msg.sender == governance
setStrategy only callable by msg.sender == governance
init is restricted to governance via msg.sender check
msg.sender is encoded as payer in MintCallbackData for deposit
msg.sender indexes userInfo and receives collected rewards
msg.sender is passed as recipient to pay for refunds and withdrawals
permit depends on block.timestamp <= deadline, a timestamp dependency
deposit reads pool for liquidity, mint and liquidityForAmounts
withdraw reads pool position to burn proportional liquidity
rerange reads pool to burn, compute ticks and mint new liquidity
rebalance reads and mutates pool state throughout its execution
init reads pool.slot0 and tickSpacing to derive initial ticks
init writes tickLower
init writes tickUpper
init sets finalized to true as a one-time guard
deposit uses tickLower to mint the position
deposit uses tickUpper to mint the position
deposit computes shares via _calcShare which uses unsafe mul/div with unbounded inputs
_earnFees adds protocol fee to accruedProtocolFees0 with unchecked arithmetic
_earnFees adds protocol fee to accruedProtocolFees1 with unchecked arithmetic
_updateFeesReward recomputes token0PerShareStored accumulator
_updateFeesReward recomputes token1PerShareStored accumulator
_updateFeesReward writes userInfo reward debt fields for the account
pay performs raw low-level token.call transfers and ETH sends via TransferHelper
rebalance invokes pool.swap with an externally controlled price limit
rerange calls pool burn/collect/mint external entry points
deposit calls pool.mint which transfers control to the mint callback
collectProtocolFees may call pool burn/collect when balances are insufficient
collectFees may call pool burn/collect when balances are insufficient
pool.swap calls back uniswapV3SwapCallback before rebalance finishes settling state
pool.mint calls back uniswapV3MintCallback which pulls tokens from the payer
permit calls ECDSA.recover which executes ecrecover on user supplied signature
collectFees decrements userInfo reward balances after payout
